metaDescription: We're on a mission The GIMA mission is to provide a go-to resource where busy health professionals can find evidence-based expertise in nutrition. A Nutritional Certification that qualifies graduates to become Registered Nutritional Consultant Practitioners (RNCP) allowing busy health professionals to achieve the credibility that comes with the RNCP credentials is the bedrock on which GIMA is built
